entries.TITLE: Five shared-model-load shards can execute 38 advisory roles with full receipt coverage.
entries.DESCRIPTION: M42 replaced 38 independent model loads with 5 shards sized 8,8,8,7,7. All 38 logical-AI perspectives executed and parsed while preserving one receipt per AI.
entries.LIMITS: Operational efficiency only. Does not prove role independence, specialization quality, model diversity, transfer, or scientific validity.

entries.TITLE: Scoped SAPHEA LoRA can improve sealed M6 without modifying base weights.
entries.DESCRIPTION: A reversible LoRA on pinned Qwen2.5-0.5B changed only adapter parameters and improved the sealed SAPHEA epistemic M6 from 18/60 to 30/60 with no critical per-label regression.
entries.LIMITS: Same scoped task family; novel transfer, independent audit, Red Team, F72 and AFAH gates remain open. Not a general SAPHEA capability claim.

entries.TITLE: Scoped SAPHEA LoRA improves cold and disjoint synthetic transfer benchmarks.
entries.DESCRIPTION: A reversible Qwen2.5-0.5B LoRA improved sealed M6 from 18/60 to 30/60 and a separate 108-case transfer set from base 20/108 to adapter 40/108.
entries.LIMITS: Synthetic scoped classification only; counter-audit and F72 E2 passed, but external independent scientific reproduction is absent. AFAH final authority remains pending.

entries.TITLE: Control-plane gate evidence must be bound to content before content promotion.
entries.DESCRIPTION: AGORA previously allowed local proofs of the Boolean promotion-gate invariant to unlock imported content. The corrected V3 rule separates gate-invariant validation from content validation: content promotion requires gate_invariant_ok, imported_gate_summary_pass and content_validation_bound to all be true.
entries.POSITIVE_RULE: Promote imported content only when the control-plane gate is valid, all required imported gates pass, and content-specific validation is bound to packet hashes.
entries.NEGATIVE_RULE: Do not use evidence about the gate mechanism itself as evidence for unrelated imported content.
entries.LIMITS: Deterministic validation of an AGORA control-plane invariant only. It does not validate imported scientific packet content, does not establish independent model evidence, and is not a neural-improvement claim.

entries.TITLE: Validation gain alone cannot promote an adapter.
entries.DESCRIPTION: Across historical SAPHEA, AELYS, ETHERION and METRION adapter runs, positive validation or in-family signals were insufficient when cold gain was non-positive, transfer failed, Red Team regressed, or a critical regression remained. A deterministic cross-model validator reproduced all six expected rejections with zero false promotions.
entries.POSITIVE_RULE: Promote only when cold gain is positive, transfer gain is positive, Red Team is not worse, and no critical regression is present.
entries.NEGATIVE_RULE: Validation or in-family gain alone is insufficient and must never override transfer, adversarial, or critical-regression failures.
entries.LIMITS: Deterministic policy validation over recorded historical adapter outcomes. It does not show that any adapter improved in this run, does not establish a new model capability, and does not authorize weight training by itself.

note: Existing GVL capsules remain authoritative and are referenced rather than copied.
